Photography marketplace · Digital + identity

Photomax

A bigger picture for creative talent.

A connected visual identity and digital experience for photographers to present their work and respond to opportunities, extended into print and exhibition design.

Format
Web, mobile, print, environment
Focus
UI design, brand identity, visual communication
01 Overview02 Decisions03 Design04 Reflection

01 / The context

The experience behind the screens.

Photomax brings a photography marketplace and a bold visual system together. The work spans a desktop experience, mobile discovery and requests, promotional materials, and exhibition spaces.

The design challenge

Photography needs room to speak for itself, but the surrounding experience still has to help people compare portfolios, understand a photographer’s specialty, and act on a request. The same identity also needs to translate beyond a screen.

02 / Design decisions

What shaped
the experience.

01

Frame the work

A near-black foundation, red framing elements, circular portrait treatments, and image-led layouts create a consistent identity around the photography.

02

Connect discovery to an opportunity

The mobile sequence moves from photographers and portfolios to event notifications, request details, acceptance, and confirmation.

03

Carry the identity into physical space

Brochures, posters, signage, and exhibition graphics reuse the same photographic composition and red-and-black system.
